# Aeris-M Soil-Moisture Sensor - Field Specification

The Aeris-M capacitive soil-moisture probe operates from -20 C to +60 C at up to 95 percent relative humidity. Revision 2 retains the 15-minute default cadence.

Document class: controlling manufacturer specification. Revision: 2. Effective date: 2031-02-01. Supersedes: Aeris-M Field Specification Revision 1 (2029-06-10), which must no longer be used for deployment decisions. Issued by Kellerman Instruments, Product Engineering.

## 1. Scope

This specification governs the deployment, calibration, and maintenance of the Aeris-M soil-moisture probe at all field sites operated under a Kellerman Instruments supply agreement. Where a distributor bulletin disagrees with this specification, this specification controls.

## 2. Sampling and measurement

- Default sampling cadence: one reading every 15 minutes.
- Measurement principle: capacitive dielectric sensing through a porous ceramic frit.
- Measurement depth: up to 120 cm below ground surface.
- Stated accuracy: plus or minus 1.8 percent volumetric water content.
- Temperature compensation: automatic across the full operating range.
- Revision 2 states accuracy as plus or minus 1.8 percent; Revision 1 stated plus or minus 2.5 percent.

## 3. Calibration

- Calibration interval: 90 days under normal service.
- Method: two-point calibration against the Kellerman reference frit standard.
- Every calibration event must be logged to the site register within 24 hours of the event.
- A probe that drifts more than 3 percentage points between calibrations must be withdrawn from service and returned for inspection.
- Revision 2 summary: the 90-day calibration interval replaces the 180-day interval set by Revision 1.

## 4. Firmware

- Reference firmware for Revision 2: version 4.2.1.
- Field firmware updates require written approval from Kellerman Instruments.
- Rollback to firmware 3.0.7 or earlier is prohibited at sites reporting to the provincial board.

## 5. Power and cell life

- Power source: one lithium thionyl chloride primary cell, factory-sealed.
- Expected cell life: 5.5 years at the 15-minute default cadence.
- Cells must never be replaced in the field; recovered units are returned to the manufacturer for cell removal.
- Revision 2 cell life at the 15-minute cadence is 5.5 years; Revision 1 stated 6.0 years at the 30-minute cadence.

## 6. Storage and handling

- Store between -30 C and +60 C in dry conditions.
- The housing must never be opened, crushed, punctured, or incinerated; see the Aeris-M Field Safety Datasheet for the mandatory handling and disposal rules.
- Probes must be transported in the factory shock sleeve.

## 7. Revision notes

Revision 2 shortens the calibration interval from the 180 days set by Revision 1 to 90 days, tightens the stated accuracy from plus or minus 2.5 percent to plus or minus 1.8 percent, raises the reference firmware from 3.0.7 to 4.2.1, reduces the expected cell life from 6.0 years to 5.5 years, and requires calibration logging within 24 hours rather than within 7 days. The operating range and housing specification are unchanged from Revision 1. Sites that calibrated under Revision 1 must recalibrate within 30 days of the effective date.
